tldr: Black Moon Lilith transiting the 9th house: autonomy and the disowned self activate through belief, study, travel, law, publishing, and spiritual perspective.
body: Black Moon Lilith moving through the 9th house can activate the disowned, uncompromising self through belief, study, travel, law, publishing, and spiritual perspective. For roughly nine months, this transit may expose where shame, control, compliance, or refusal has gathered around these topics. You refuse imposed belief; raw truth-seeking that will not accept a borrowed worldview. Rejects imposed belief and conventional study in favor of instinctive knowing. Periodic, sweeping rethinks of worldview and values are part of the pattern.
business: The disowned self activates through belief, study, travel, law, publishing, and spiritual perspective. Forges a hard-won, independent philosophy.
shadow: Zealotry, or rejecting all meaning to stay free.
advice: Reclaim autonomy in the 9th house without letting reaction make the decision for you. Work with belief, study, travel, law, publishing, and spiritual perspective directly and consciously.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
